articles.title: Your Lost Dog Can Now Call Home from Anywhere — Even the Middle of Nowhere!
articles.summary: A new dog collar connects to satellites, so if your pup runs off in the woods with no cell signal, you can still find them. Fi's Ultra tracker uses SpaceX's Starlink to send your dog's location from almost anywhere on Earth.

articles.title: Scientists Just Built a Weird Quantum Material That Was Only a Dream for 10 Years!
articles.summary: Physicists in Finland created a super-thin crystal that lets electricity flow only along its edges. This "topological crystalline insulator" was predicted over a decade ago but never made until now. It could lead to faster, cooler electronics.

articles.title: What If You Tried to Chop a Particle of Light in Half? You'd Get a Crazy Light Explosion!
articles.summary: Physicists calculated what would happen if you tried to split a photon — a particle of light. Instead of two pieces, you'd get a burst of up to infinite new photons. The math shows quantum weirdness at its best.
